new_record.canonical_situation: The driver cannot locate a package on the van at the delivery stop
new_record.normalized_description: A manifested or expected delivery package cannot be found on the van when the driver reaches the address.
new_record.authoritative_rule: Check the main label addresses on nearby packages for a mix-up or stale SID sticker, search for no more than 5–8 minutes, attempt delivery if the package is found later, and call the BC for advice if returning would be too far out of the way.
applicability: Driver is at or near the delivery address
The expected package cannot be located on the van
exceptions: This is not the no-barcode or Key Enter procedure

required_procedure.action: Check the main-label address on nearby packages; the package may be mixed up, or a SID sticker from a previous day may be causing confusion.
Search for no more than 5–8 minutes.
If you find the package later on the route, attempt delivery then.
If the address is too far out of the way when you find it, call your BC for advice.

prohibited_actions: Do not route this situation into the no-barcode or Key Enter procedure
Do not spend more than 5–8 minutes searching at the stop
escalation_requirements: Call the BC when the later delivery would be too far out of the way
driver_question_variants: Cannot find the package
Package is missing on the van
At the address but cannot locate the box
Expected package not where the SID says
Found the package later on route
new_record.concise_ready_route_answer: Check nearby packages’ main-label addresses and look for a stale SID mix-up, but search no more than 5–8 minutes. If found later, attempt delivery; if the address is too far out of the way, call your BC.
new_record.more_info_answer: This is a package-location problem on the van, not a missing-barcode or Key Enter situation.
